SELECT h.id, h.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, h.title, h.content, h.attachment_url AS attachmentUrl, h.attachment_name AS attachmentName, h.deadline, h.create_time AS createTime, hs.id AS submissionId, CASE WHEN hs.id IS NOT NULL AND hs.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS submitStatus, hs.score, hs.comment, hs.submit_time AS submitTime FROM homework h INNER JOIN course c ON h.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN selection_record sr ON sr.course_id = h.course_id AND sr.student_id = #{studentId} AND sr.status = 1 LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON hs.homework_id = h.id AND hs.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE h.status = 1
AND h.course_id = #{dto.courseId}
AND h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.title}, '%')
ORDER BY h.create_time DESC

SELECT hs.id, hs.homework_id AS homeworkId, hs.student_id AS studentId, u.real_name AS studentName, u.username AS studentNo, cls.name AS className, hs.content, hs.attachment_url AS attachmentUrl, hs.attachment_name AS attachmentName, hs.score, hs.comment, hs.submit_time AS submitTime, hs.grade_time AS gradeTime FROM homework_submission hs INNER JOIN sys_user u ON hs.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN org_class cls ON u.class_id = cls.id WHERE hs.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND hs.status = 1 ORDER BY hs.submit_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selection_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
